_comment: ops#415: hand-curated inventory of every GitHub Actions secret referenced anywhere in the fleet's workflows — NAMES and WHERE THEY LIVE only, never values. Validated against a live grep of every fleet repo's .github/workflows/*.yml by scripts/check-secret-health.mjs (--sync), not generated from it — a generator would carry prose false positives (a secrets.X mention inside a comment) straight into the registry. 15 distinct secret NAMES; CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN and DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL are each a SEPARATE stored secret per repo (GitHub secrets are per-repo), listed once here with every repo that holds a copy. GITHUB_TOKEN is excluded — GitHub injects it automatically per job; it is never a stored, rotatable secret.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_URL
secrets.purpose: The ops Postgres/Supabase project's REST endpoint. Not itself a credential, but every Supabase-backed feature constructs its API calls from it.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: Every leads/tasks/digest read or write in /ops throws immediately — the app cannot reach its database at all.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY
secrets.purpose: Server-side Supabase auth for every serverless function under api/ — bypasses RLS.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: Every api/*.ts function that touches Supabase 500s; the whole app's data layer goes dark.

secrets.name: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Supabase MANAGEMENT API / CLI token — migrations, project config, branch operations.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: `supabase db push` / any CI step that manages the project (not row data) fails; day-to-day app reads/writes are unaffected.

secrets.name: FIGMA_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Reads Figma files/variables for the figma-sync scripts (model/push/snapshot/drift check).
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: check:figma-drift and figma:* scripts fail with a 401/403; Figma sync silently stops advancing.

secrets.name: FIGMA_FILE_KEY
secrets.purpose: The target Figma file id the sync scripts read/write — an identifier, not a credential.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: figma-sync scripts point at nothing; every call 404s.

secrets.name: OPS_AGENT_KEY
secrets.purpose: Shared secret the fleet's dispatched-agent endpoints check before accepting a write (see ops#380).
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: Agent-authenticated API routes reject every request; dispatched fleet tasks cannot report back.

secrets.name: RALPH_WATCHDOG_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: A GitHub token the ralph-watchdog.yml scheduled job uses when GITHUB_TOKEN's default scope is insufficient (statuses/checks read across the merge boundary).
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: scripts/ralph-watchdog.mjs fails closed with a 401/403 and TOKEN_HINT — the wedge-detection job stops silently until someone reads the run log.

secrets.name: PAGESPEED_API_KEY
secrets.purpose: Google PageSpeed Insights API key for scripts/audit-sites.mjs's site-quality scoring.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: audit-sites fails every call; site-quality scores stop updating (ci-dispatch only, so this is silent until someone runs it by hand).

secrets.name: PII_DENYLIST
secrets.purpose: Newline-separated denylist text the check-pii gate matches against (client names, real identifiers) — a data blob, not an authenticatable credential.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: check-pii runs on generic patterns only — the exact gap docs/ai/SESSION-BOARD.md's 2026-09-17 entry already flags: a green check-pii does not mean clean.

secrets.name: CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Auth for the fleet's `@claude`-mentioned executor workflows and the Ralph engine's claude-code-action steps, billed against Adrian's Max subscription (never a metered API key). A SEPARATE stored secret per repo, same value pasted into each.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: Every @claude-dispatched task and every Ralph iteration in that repo fails at the first claude-code-action step; the fleet-executor and the whole Ralph loop for that repo go dark.
secrets.rotateUrl: run `claude setup-token` locally and re-paste the value into every repo below

secrets.name: DISCORD_WEBHOOK_URL
secrets.purpose: Webhook every fleet repo's merge/notify/wedge-alert steps POST to. A SEPARATE stored secret per repo, same value pasted into each. Not actively probed with a live ping — that would spam the real channel on every scheduled health-check run.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: That repo's merge/wedge/self-heal-exhausted alerts silently stop reaching Discord; the workflow itself still succeeds (every caller guards on an empty value and exits 0), so this is invisible without checking.
secrets.rotateUrl: recreate the webhook in the target Discord channel's Integrations settings, then re-paste into every repo below

secrets.name: NPM_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Publishes @hirobius/design-system to public npm on release.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: release.yml's changesets publish step fails; a Version Packages PR can merge with nothing actually reaching npm.

secrets.name: RELEASE_PAT
secrets.purpose: Fine-grained PAT that authors/pushes the Version Packages release PR, so it gets real CI (a GITHUB_TOKEN-authored PR never triggers workflow runs — see release.yml's own header). Added hds#267 to break a release deadlock; the finding that opened this issue.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: release.yml's own guard step fails loud and names the fix already; if that guard is ever removed, the deadlock this secret exists to fix returns silently.

secrets.name: CHROMATIC_PROJECT_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Publishes Storybook visual-regression baselines + the hosted library to chromatic.com.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: chromatic.yml green-skips (by design, via the CHROMATIC_ENABLED variable guard) rather than failing — so a lapsed token looks identical to a token that was never configured, until someone checks chromatic.com directly.

secrets.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Publishes the generated component reference site (docs-site.yml) to Vercel.
secrets.breaksWhenMissing: docs-site.yml's own guard step fails loud and names the fix already, so this one already meets the fail-loud standing rule.
